question: Which cloud model should run the production dream extractor shim: Sonnet 5 (incumbent) or Opus 5? (Fable 5 excluded as a candidate on cost — user decision 2026-08-02 — its July numbers remain analysis evidence only.)
context: The July full-78 comparison left this open: direction favored bigger models in every view but nothing was significant, and the 2026-07-27+ serving changes (BM25 fusion, set-slot surfacing) later staled every July number as a comparator. Both arms here are fresh same-harness runs: identical bench code, identical v2 prompt via the same shim override mechanism, identical reproducible Qwen answerer+judge.

rag_control.note: byte-identical contexts, zero flips — comparison is clean

reading: Opus wins the cortex arm 5/0 paired — no question flips the other way — at p=0.063 (permutation; the exact one-sided sign probability of 5/0 is 0.031). This replicates the July direction on the first methodologically clean pairing.
The hybrid arm shows zero difference: raw-turn context rescues Sonnet's cortex misses, so the gap matters exactly in proportion to how much production leans on pure-cortex recall.
Opus supersedes 29% more (283 vs 220) with richer banks — the gain is update discipline plus coverage, not spam; but cortex answer contexts cost ~1.9x tokens.
n=78 is the KU pool's ceiling; a definitive p<0.05 needs the LME-500 harness extension (tracked). 5/0 with a dead-flat control is nonetheless the strongest evidence yet.
recommendation: Evidence favors swapping the shim to claude-opus-5 if the per-dream Max-plan cost is acceptable; the swap is a one-line launcher change (ops/install-shim-autostart.ps1 model arg) and trivially reversible. Deployment deliberately NOT executed — cost is the user's call. If cost matters more than the last 6 points of pure-cortex accuracy, staying on Sonnet is defensible: hybrid (the production-realistic arm) is identical.
caveats: Answerer/judge is the local reproducible Qwen 27B; absolute numbers are not comparable to GPT-4o-judged external publications.
KU-oracle measures the supersession-heavy slice; other question types unmeasured (LME-500 extension pending).
Opus arm ran once; the 0/0 rag control bounds harness noise at zero for this pairing, but extractor-side run-to-run variance of the shim itself is unmeasured.
